text_block_list.text: —Right before the Arima Kinen. Christmas.
As for Ikuno Dictus and me—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Shall we get going, then?

With the Arima Kinen approaching, we 
decided to dedicate the entire day to rest 
as suggested by Ikuno Dictus...

"Normally, it would have been fine to let 
Ikuno Dictus spend her time however she 
liked, but—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Since it's Christmas, Trainer, would you 
like to take the day off with me?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If you have other plans, Trainer, it 
really doesn't matter, but...

"I have no plans. That's because I left it 
open as a buffer to respond to any 
unforeseen circumstances leading up to the 
Arima Kinen."
choice_data_list:
Well... I don't have any plans... not 
really.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: If that is the case, how about this?

...The light in Ikuno Dictus's eyes speaks 
more eloquently than words. Even at times 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

And that is how I ended up accompanying 
Ikuno Dictus on her day off—
choice_data_list: Is there anywhere you'd like to go, Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: No, I'm not thinking about anything.

It sounded completely uncharacteristic of 
her, given how meticulously she usually 
plans things out.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I deliberately didn't make any plans 
today. Let's just stroll around and enjoy 
ourselves as we please.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. That's fine.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Let's head toward town for now.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Hmm, this hat is quite nice.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Tannhauser-san's influence, 
lately I've... been looking around to see 
if there's anything that suits me—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that hat. I think it would look great 
on you, Trainer. Would you like to try it 
on?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. McQueen-san is as popular as ever. 
She has so much merchandise too.
choice_data_list: Hey, Ikuno's is over there too.
Look, Ikuno's is over there too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is this the one I supervised the other 
day?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing it actually lined up in the shop 
like this always makes me feel a little 
ticklish inside.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, I want you to sing along with 
me, nya!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Pretty☆Lovely☆Tasty☆ Become delicious, 
dashi chazuke~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Pretty☆Lovely☆Tasty☆ Become delicious, 
dashi chazuke~!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! You did super well, miss-nya! Now 
our totally pretty and delicious sea bream 
dashi chazuke set is complete-nya!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
These absurdly heaped-on, mysterious 
pretty elements feel completely out of 
place for an ochazuke specialty shop...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
What a wonderfully fun and stimulating 
shop this is, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list:
You're right. (Well, as long as Ikuno is 
having fun...)

text_block_list.text:
"And so, Ikuno Dictus and I strolled 
around at our own pace, enjoying the 
moment—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...What a truly Christmas-like sight.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We've walked quite far from the academy, 
so shall we head back soon?
choice_data_list:
...Ikuno, were you able to get proper rest 
today?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...? Yes, I was able to rest, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Why do you ask such a question?

Ikuno Dictus has a lot of friends. Perhaps 
spending time with them instead of me 
would have offered a better form of rest.

"I can't help but feel that way. She's 
still a student, a girl with a bright 
future ahead of her."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Did you have fun today, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Same here.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm here with you right now.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Could you please accept that, just for 
today?

Those earnest eyes gaze straight back at 
me. That brilliance has always, without 
fail...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. Very much so.

Afterward, I walked alongside Ikuno 
Dictus, taking a leisurely stroll back to 
the academy.

The starry sky I saw on the way home felt 
vastly wider than usual in the clear 
winter air...

It became something I would never forget 
for the rest of my days.

Afterward, I walked alongside Ikuno 
Dictus, taking a leisurely stroll back to 
the academy.

The starry sky I saw on the way home felt 
vastly wider than usual in the clear 
winter air...

It became something I will never, ever 
forget—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: —Ah, Ikuno's back! Heyyy!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Ikuno, dear. It's interrogation 
time~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hey-hey-hey-hey-hey! Where'd you go?! You 
went out with your Trainer, didn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you came to us for advice, and we 
helped clear Ikuno's schedule, so we've 
got the right to hear all about it, don't 
we~?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I believe that is a natural demand 
to make.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Th-This guy's totally relaxed...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ikuno! More importantly, let's hurry 
and eat snacks! Turbo went and bought them 
with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a party? Sounds lovely, let's 
certainly have one.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Just one thing for now, just one! Was it 
fun!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It was the best day off.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ohyaaaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, everyone, please remember this 
one thing.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you really are... my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
…………Coming from you, that's seriously 
deep.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufuâ Do you think so?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (...Thank you very much, Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to you, this has truly become... 
an unforgettable Christmas...)
